papers.title: scAnyOmics: Foundation-Model Distillation for Any-to-Any Completion of Multi-omics Virtual Cells
papers.abstract: Recent advances in single-cell technologies have enabled the profiling of multiple molecular modalities, including transcriptomics, proteomics, and chromatin accessibility, providing a more comprehensive understanding of cellular states. However, integrating heterogeneous modalities and predicting missing molecular information remain challenging, particularly when paired measurements are limited. Here, we introduce scAnyOmics, a generative framework that distills knowledge from a frozen single-cell foundation model into a multimodal student model. scAnyOmics integrates scRNA-seq, protein-marker measurements, and scATAC-seq into a shared representation, enabling cross-modal prediction and reconstruction of missing modalities. We assembled 690,880 cells from six publicly available studies, covering both paired and partially paired multi-omics measurements, to systematically evaluate its predictive performance. We further evaluated scAnyOmics on held-out donor data, where it outperformed baseline methods across multiple evaluation metrics. Beyond cross-modal reconstruction, we explored its applications in cell-type annotation, perturbation-response prediction, and biological age estimation. Overall, scAnyOmics provides a unified framework for integrating incomplete single-cell multi-omics data and transferring pretrained biological knowledge, supporting the development of virtual cell models across diverse cellular contexts and experimental platforms.

summary.takeaway: 提出 scAnyOmics，将冻结的单细胞基础模型知识蒸馏到多模态学生模型，实现单细胞多组学缺失模态的跨模态预测与重建。
summary.methods: 整合 scRNA-seq、蛋白标记测量和 scATAC-seq 到共享表示；汇总 6 项公开研究的 690,880 个细胞（含配对与部分配对数据）进行评估，并在留出供体数据上与基线方法比较；还探索细胞类型注释、扰动响应预测和生物学年龄估计等应用。
summary.relevance: 直接对应虚拟细胞与 Cell Foundation Model 主题，涉及预训练知识迁移以及跨模态理解与生成。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅笼统说明在多个指标上优于基线，未给出具体数值或统计细节；对扰动响应预测和年龄估计等下游应用未报告定量结果；数据限于六项公开研究，泛化性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) achieve remarkable success on diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage language-based chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation. As a result, existing reasoning-augmented UMMs often fail to inherit the test-time scaling and fine-grained controllability observed in large language models. We attribute this failure to a fundamental modality mismatch: reasoning is performed in a discrete token space, whereas image generation operates in a continuous space. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Latent Reasoning framework in Continuous space (LARC), which alleviates the token-level bottleneck by reasoning over continuous hidden states. Specifically, the training framework consists of two stages: (i) curriculum supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and (ii) information-gain reinforcement learning (RL). First, the curriculum SFT stage gradually converts token-level reasoning into latent reasoning. Subsequently, the information-gain RL stage self-evolves latent reasoning without ground truth supervision. Experiments across diverse text-to-image generation benchmarks show that LARC consistently improves generation quality, prompt following, and compositional fidelity. Notably, LARC achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval with a 7%p gain over BAGEL and demonstrates clear test-time scaling behavior, outperforming token-based generation under both parallel and sequential test-time scaling strategies.

summary.takeaway: 提出 LARC，在连续隐状态空间中进行推理，以缓解统一多模态模型中离散 token 推理与连续图像生成之间的模态不匹配。
summary.methods: 两阶段训练：课程式监督微调将 token 级推理逐步转为隐空间推理，再用信息增益强化学习在无真实标签下自演化；在多个文本到图像生成基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型推理、强化学习与多模态学习，尤其是跨模态理解与生成中的推理增强。
summary.caveat: 摘要只给出 GenEval 上相对 BAGEL 提升 7 个百分点的结果，其他基准仅定性描述；方法在图像生成任务上验证，向其他模态或统一理解任务的迁移未讨论。

papers.title: ImplicitHop: Evaluating knowledge integration across context and memory
papers.abstract: The ability to integrate new information and deduce its consequences is central to learning, understanding, and reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Whether information arrives during training or in-context, models must not only store local facts, but propagate their long-range implications globally. To explore information integration in LLMs, we introduce two complementary natural language benchmarks for large-scale evaluation of deductive reasoning as a function of inference depth. The first is a formal graph benchmark enabling controlled evaluation over a wide range of graph topologies and integration tasks; the second is a knowledge composition benchmark grounded in real-world knowledge graphs. We use these benchmarks to compare knowledge integration from information encoded in context versus information encoded in model weights during pretraining, evaluating a set of open models implicitly, without chain of thought. We find that accuracy decays sharply with increased composition length for both pretrained and in-context knowledge. Information presented in-context, however, substantially outperforms deduction over information encoded in weights. These results quantify a fundamental limitation of current models with direct implications for prompt-based control of agent behavior and for continual learning strategies, and they provide a foundation for developing training, prompting, and integration methods that support deeper reasoning.

summary.takeaway: 构建两个基准评估 LLM 随推理深度增加的知识整合能力，发现预训练权重中的知识与上下文提供的知识在演绎推理中均随组合长度增加而准确率急剧下降，且上下文信息明显优于权重内知识。
summary.methods: 提出一个形式化图基准（控制图拓扑与整合任务）和一个基于真实知识图谱的知识组合基准；在无思维链设置下对多个开放模型比较上下文知识与预训练权重知识的推理表现。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型、知识图谱、持续学习与预训练等主题，为提示控制和持续学习策略提供依据。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体数值、模型清单或推理深度范围；结论基于无思维链的隐式评估，未涵盖思维链或工具增强等设置。

papers.title: When Depth Lies: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Mirror-Induced RGB-D Ambiguity
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have made significant progress in spatial reasoning, particularly by integrating RGB images with depth data, which is often assumed to faithfully reflect physical distances. However, mirrors violate this assumption: they distort depth readings while reproducing object appearances, making reflections difficult to distinguish from real objects. As existing benchmarks rarely consider such reflective scenarios, VLM performance in mirror scenes remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce a mirror-centric RGB-D dataset from reflective scenes to evaluate the spatial reasoning capabilities of state-of-the-art VLMs in these scenarios. Specifically, we collect 1,011 RGB-D images from 525 real-world scenes, spanning diverse indoor and outdoor environments, six reflective surface types, and both daytime and nighttime conditions. All images are annotated with reflective surface region masks and mask annotations for both directly observed and mirror-reflected objects. Then, we curate a benchmark named MIRA-Bench (Mirror-Induced Reasoning Ambiguity Benchmark), comprising 14,140 QA pairs across eight sub-tasks organized into three cognitive levels: Reflection-aware Perception, Spatial Reasoning, and Scene-level Decision-making. We evaluate state-of-the-art VLMs on MIRA-Bench and find consistent failures across tasks: models misclassify whether objects are directly observed or reflected, fail to match reflected instances to their real-world counterparts, and produce erroneous spatial inferences. Remarkably, providing depth data actually degrades reasoning performance, implying that VLMs cannot identify incorrect depth in mirror scenes. The code and data are available at https://github.com/EvaYin-cloud/MIRA-Bench

summary.takeaway: 构建 MIRA-Bench，揭示视觉语言模型在镜面反射场景下难以区分真实物体与镜像，且额外提供深度数据反而降低推理表现。
summary.methods: 采集 525 个真实场景的 1,011 张 RGB-D 图像，覆盖室内外、六类反射面及昼夜条件，标注反射区域和直接/镜像物体掩码；构建 14,140 个 QA 对，分三个认知层次、八个子任务，评估先进 VLM。
summary.relevance: 属于多模态学习与跨模态理解评估，关注 RGB-D 空间推理的可靠性。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅定性描述模型一致失败及深度数据导致性能下降，未给出具体指标数值；基准聚焦镜面场景，结论向一般空间推理的推广需谨慎。

papers.title: Enhancing Knowledge Entity Relation Extraction in Abstracts and Full-text Content of Academic Articles Using Large Language Models
papers.abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of large pre-trained language models (LLMs) for knowledge entity relation extraction (KERE) from academic papers. Existing studies have examined individual types of LLM-based strategies and evaluated model performance using metrics such as precision and recall. To provide a broader evaluation, this study investigates multiple strategies, including closed-source LLM-based CoT prompting, LoRA-adapted open-source LLMs, LLM-enhanced small pre-trained language models (SLMs), and SLM-enhanced closed-source LLMs. In addition, this study introduces two strategies, namely SLM-enhanced open-source LLMs and closed-source LLM-enhanced open-source LLMs. These strategies are evaluated from multiple perspectives, including metrics, their ability to mitigate errors observed in SLMs, and potential directions for model optimization. This study manually constructs two annotated datasets in the NLP domain, covering Abstract and Full-Text datasets. Experimental results show that the LoRA-adapted T5 model achieves the highest macro F1 scores of 0.7408 and 0.7013 on the Abstract and Full-Text datasets, respectively. SLMs also benefit from LLM-generated entity descriptions under the LLM-enhanced SLM strategy. Error analysis further reveals that the effectiveness of LLM-based strategies in mitigating SLM errors varies across error types. Based on the identified limitations and error patterns of these strategies, several optimization directions are proposed. In addition, combining strategies with different error patterns further improves KERE performance.

summary.takeaway: 系统比较多种基于大语言模型的知识实体关系抽取策略，并新增两种混合策略；LoRA 适配的 T5 在摘要与全文数据集上取得最高 macro F1。
summary.methods: 研究包括闭源 LLM 的 CoT 提示、LoRA 适配开源 LLM、LLM 增强小预训练模型、SLM 增强闭源 LLM，以及新提出的 SLM 增强开源 LLM 和闭源 LLM 增强开源 LLM；在 NLP 领域人工构建摘要与全文两个标注数据集上进行评估与错误分析。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型与图谱构建与表示，涉及学术文本中的知识图谱构建。
summary.caveat: 数据集为 NLP 领域人工构建，规模与跨领域泛化性未在摘要中说明；结果依赖特定模型组合，错误缓解效果因错误类型而异。

papers.title: KEEPER: Learning Control-Sufficient Textual Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Recursive textual memory can carry earlier errors into later updates, yet task performance alone does not establish memory reliability. We define self-consistency bias as the persistence of incorrect claims already present in the incoming memory. We present KEEPER, a comparative analysis of four auxiliary objectives along information-content and update-sensitivity axes within a shared recursive interface, examining how supervision targets relate to agent performance. Among evaluated conditions, reward-related prediction achieve the highest task performance before and after offline reinforcement learning, outperforming joint supervision. A claim-level analysis of one baseline trajectory documents error persistence despite corrective observations. Together, these analyses motivate evaluating error persistence and valid-information retention alongside task outcomes.

summary.takeaway: 提出 KEEPER，在统一递归接口下比较四种辅助监督目标，发现奖励相关预测在离线强化学习前后均取得最高任务表现，并强调应同时评估错误持续性与有效信息保留。
summary.methods: 定义“自一致性偏差”为传入记忆中错误主张的持续存在；沿信息内容与更新敏感性两个轴比较四种辅助目标；对一条基线轨迹做主张级错误持续性分析。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与强化学习主题，关注长程智能体的文本记忆可靠性。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明具体任务、数据集或量化结果；主张级分析仅针对一条基线轨迹，结论的统计普遍性有限。

papers.title: Supervised and LLM-Augmented Cardinality Estimation for Similarity Queries on Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Over the past decades, query cardinality estimation on relational databases has been proven crucial, enabling the result size estimation of all sub-plans of each query. This allowed query optimizers to design efficient query plans, towards minimizing the query response time. Lately, knowledge graphs are being preferred over traditional databases in various applications, due to their ability to represent complex relationships and semantic meaning in a domain-specific context. In this work, we present a novel approach for supervised similarity-aware cardinality estimation on knowledge graphs that incorporates similarities into the model training process, thus treating them as first-class citizens. To this end, we present SCE-KG, a model that employs a novel encoding scheme for cardinality estimation, named SGsplit. We further extend our approach by leveraging a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate training queries that resemble realistic user workloads, and show that combining LLM-generated and random walk samples consistently improves estimation accuracy on test workloads generated by two independent LLMs. Our experimental evaluation reveals that our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art techniques in terms of prediction error, achieving 40x and 37x improvement for star and chain queries, respectively (95th percentile), whereas its online overhead accounts for less than 0.05% of the average query execution time and less than 1% of the average query planning time, showing a sub-millisecond latency in all cases.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SCE-KG，将相似性作为一等公民纳入知识图谱相似性查询的基数估计训练，并用 LLM 生成查询扩充训练数据以提升估计精度。
summary.methods: 采用新的 SGsplit 编码方案；结合 LLM 生成的类真实用户查询与随机游走样本训练；在两个独立 LLM 生成的工作负载上评估预测误差与在线开销。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型、检索增强与对齐以及知识图谱，涉及知识图谱查询优化。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告的 40 倍和 37 倍改进为 95 百分位下的相对提升，绝对误差水平未给出；评估工作负载由 LLM 生成，真实生产负载下的表现待验证。

papers.title: TalentRL: Strategy-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Hierarchical Skill Routing
papers.abstract: Natural-language skills enable large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedures across tasks, yet most systems retrieve individual skills from a flat SkillBank without explicitly modeling the high-level strategy that governs their selection and use. We introduce TalentRL, a strategy-guided reinforcement learning framework for hierarchical routing over procedural memory. Coarse-grained talents represent recurring strategies for skill use, while fine-grained skills provide executable procedures. For each task, the policy model selects a talent that guides execution and softly prioritizes its associated skills during similarity-based retrieval. However, since task outcomes depend jointly on talent selection, retrieved skill context, and downstream execution, terminal rewards alone cannot isolate the contribution of the routing decision. TalentRL therefore trains talent routing with reward contrasts between rollouts of the same task under matched interventions on the talent-conditioned context, and optimizes downstream execution with group-relative advantages. Across seven open-domain and multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, talent-aware supervised fine-tuning improves average success rate by 7.53%, 6.71%, and 9.21% over the corresponding zero-shot baselines for Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B, respectively. Reinforcement learning further improves these SFT checkpoints by 7.58% to 9.32%, and TalentRL achieves the highest average success rate among all compared methods on all three backbones. On the agentic benchmarks ALFWorld and WebShop, TalentRL achieves the highest ALFWorld success rate (99.3%) and the highest WebShop score (90.7) among all compared methods.

summary.takeaway: 提出 TalentRL，以策略引导的强化学习在程序性记忆上做分层路由：粗粒度 talent 选择策略、细粒度 skill 提供可执行过程，并据匹配干预下的奖励对比训练路由。
summary.methods: talent 感知监督微调后在 Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B 上做强化学习；用同一任务在 talent 条件上下文匹配干预下的 rollout 奖励对比训练 talent 路由，用组相对优势优化下游执行；在七个开放域和多跳问答基准及 ALFWorld、WebShop 上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型、检索增强与对齐及强化学习，涉及技能检索与智能体策略学习。
summary.caveat: 摘要结果基于三个特定骨干模型和选定基准；奖励对比依赖干预设计，其稳健性未在摘要中讨论；未报告计算成本或训练稳定性。

papers.title: Implicit Assumptions About Tasks in Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Continual learning is the study of how a model accumulates knowledge from data received over time, rather than all at once. In practice, this is typically achieved by dividing a dataset into tasks and presenting them sequentially. Explanations of the resulting measurements take into account factors such as the similarity between segments, the rate at which the data changes and the order of presentation. Each of these factors can be defined in terms of the underlying data, the partition imposed on it, or the learner that encounters it. These levels do not necessarily coincide, and it is usually left implicit which level a reported quantity refers to. We separate these and identify which properties acquire a value at each level. In controlled teacher--student experiments, we demonstrate that partitioning the same underlying trajectory at different levels of granularity, changing the order of presentation, and varying the similarity structure of the underlying data all result in different measured outcomes. We review representative benchmarks to determine which of these properties are stated. Where the underlying data cannot be inspected, as in foundation models built on undisclosed pre-training corpora, its properties are inherited by the model's initial state, and the training applied on top of it can be described.

summary.takeaway: 论文指出持续学习中关于“任务”的隐含假设：数据、划分与学习器三个层面的属性常被混为一谈，而粒度、顺序与相似性结构会改变测量结果。
summary.methods: 提出将数据本体、施加的数据划分与学习器三个层级区分开，并在受控的教师—学生实验中改变划分粒度、呈现顺序与数据相似性结构，同时审查代表性基准中报告了哪些属性。
summary.relevance: 直接针对持续学习的评测与任务定义问题，并讨论在预训练语料不可见的基础模型上，数据属性由初始状态继承。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体实验数值或所审查基准的名称，结论的普适性需阅读全文确认。

papers.title: SACQ: Structure-Aware Codebook Quantization for Ultra-Low-Bit Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable capable robot behavior, but their large memory footprint limits deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms. Weight quantization is a natural remedy, yet post-training quantization (PTQ) recipes inherited from large language models degrade when applied to VLAs at ultra-low precision. Existing low-bit PTQ methods often fail to explicitly account for the structure of downstream operations and allocate precision without considering its effect on the policy actions. We introduce SACQ, an ultra- low-bit weight-only vector-codebook quantization framework for VLAs. SACQ combines (1) structure-aware codebook fitting with role-specific quadratic metrics that reflect input statistics and downstream sensitivity; (2) action-aware mixed-bit allocation based on the increase in final-action error as individual layers are compressed; and (3) two-stage post-quantization refinement that reassigns codeword indices with second-order error compensation and calibrates codebooks and row-group scales against the decoded action. Using GR00T N1.7, SACQ achieves 93.85% average success across four LIBERO suites at 1.5 bits per language/action weight while reducing model memory by 4.83x. With INT8 activation quantization and low-precision attention, it retains 93.55% success while running 1.51x faster than BF16. On SimplER, SACQ further achieves 63.76% and 52.27% success under Visual Matching and Variant Aggregation at 2 bits per language/action weight, compared to 58.90% and 53.45% for BF16, respectively.

summary.takeaway: 提出SACQ，一种面向VLA模型的超低比特权重向量码本量化框架，在保持任务成功率的同时显著压缩内存。
summary.methods: 包含结构感知的码本拟合与角色特定二次度量、基于动作误差增量的混合比特分配，以及带二阶误差补偿和码本/行组尺度校准的两阶段后量化精化；在GR00T N1.7上于LIBERO和SimplER评测。
summary.relevance: 涉及大模型压缩与多模态（视觉—语言—动作）模型部署，与语言模型和跨模态理解主题相关。
summary.caveat: 结果主要基于GR00T N1.7与LIBERO/SimplER，泛化到其他VLA架构与真实机器人平台尚待验证。

papers.title: Hawkeye: Reading Illegible Text with Vision Language Models
papers.abstract: While modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have been remarkably successful in general scene text recognition, they consistently struggle with the long-tail distribution of text that is degraded by motion blur or low resolution. These limitations are particularly apparent in egocentric applications like smart glasses, where text is often captured in noisy environments. In this paper, we introduce the \textbf{BSTRB} (Blurry Scene Text Recognition Benchmark), a novel benchmark of 8,398 noisy image samples with high-fidelity annotations derived from 1,699 real-world video sequences. To support this, we present \textbf{Hawkeye}, a VLM fine-tuned on BSTRB to read and reason about illegible text by leveraging contextual priors and pixel-level alignment. Our results show that \name matches much larger VLMs on BSTRB overall and exceeds them on text at or below 20 pixels, in a single pass suited to real-time deployment. We characterize the resolution at which current VLMs begin to fail.

summary.takeaway: 构建模糊场景文本识别基准BSTRB，并微调出Hawkeye模型，在小像素文本上可媲美或超过更大VLM。
summary.methods: 从1,699段真实视频序列构建8,398个噪声图像样本及高保真标注，基于该基准微调VLM，利用上下文先验与像素级对齐进行识别与推理。
summary.relevance: 面向多模态VLM在退化文本上的长尾识别能力，与跨模态理解及智能眼镜等第一视角应用相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告相对比较与定性趋势，未给出具体精度数值；实时性主张需硬件条件说明。

papers.title: Disagreement-informed arbitration for gene regulatory network inference: A score-level meta-classifier and a diagnostic typology of inter-method conflict.
papers.abstract: Gene regulatory network inference methods routinely disagree about individual edges, and practitioners resolve those conflicts by choosing one method or averaging them all. We ask whether the conflict can instead be arbitrated per edge. A gradient-boosted classifier is trained on the raw scores that ten inference methods-correlation-based, information-theoretic, sparse-regression and tree-ensemble, including GENIE3, GRNBoost2, CLR and ARACNe-assign to each candidate regulator-target pair, so that the weight given to each method varies from edge to edge. Across six single-cell perturbation screens spanning four cell types, arbitration improves on mean ensembling by +0.056 AUROC on Adamson and +0.083 on Shifrut under target-grouped cross-validation. The evaluation protocol turns out to matter more than the model. Edge-level cross-validation, standard in this literature, inflates apparent gains by 0.060 AUROC through target-gene leakage-comparable to the entire honest improvement. The effect is far larger for methods that represent genes implicitly: a supervised graph-attention link predictor trained on identical folds scores AUROC 0.930 under edge-level cross-validation, better than anything else we evaluate, and 0.533 once target genes are held out. Any method that parameterises genes is exposed, which covers most graph- and embedding-based approaches. A five-category typology of inter-method conflict localises where arbitration pays off, with the largest gains on edges where the methods disagree and the smallest where they already agree, while adding nothing as model input; we therefore report it as a diagnostic instrument rather than a modelling contribution. We also characterise what the ground truth measures: most perturbed genes in widely used screens are not transcription factors, and a mediation screen bounds how much of the perturbation response can be direct.

summary.takeaway: 提出按边仲裁基因调控网络推断方法分歧的元分类器，并揭示边级交叉验证因目标基因泄漏而严重高估性能。
summary.methods: 以十种推断方法（含GENIE3、GRNBoost2、CLR、ARACNe）的原始得分为输入训练梯度提升分类器，在六个单细胞扰动筛选、四种细胞类型上用目标分组交叉验证评估，并构建五种冲突类型的诊断分类。
summary.relevance: 直接针对单细胞扰动数据上的GRN推断与评测协议问题，对方法比较与基准设计有警示意义。
summary.caveat: 诚实增益幅度有限（+0.056/+0.083 AUROC），作者自述冲突分类为诊断工具而非建模贡献；结论依赖所选取的筛选数据集。

papers.title: RTL-Interact: Training EDA-Interactive Models for Multi-Task RTL Design
papers.abstract: Large language models offer a promising route to register-transfer-level (RTL) design, but reliable implementations require checking and revision based on electronic design automation (EDA) tools' feedback. Existing RTL-specialized models often lack learned interaction with such EDA tools or rely on separate generation and repair components. We introduce RTL-Interact, a multi-task post-training framework that trains a single RTL-specialized model to generate RTL, construct task-appropriate EDA checks, and revise implementations using tool feedback. The framework combines automatically constructed multi-task demonstrations with staged supervision from chain-of-thought to tool-integrated reasoning. We further introduce Pattern-Aware Policy Optimization (PAPO) for multi-task reinforcement learning. PAPO augments Group Relative Policy Optimization with correctness-gated rewards that favor concise successful checking while rewarding effective revision, and uses task grouping to preserve coverage across objectives. On CVDP, RTL-Interact-32B achieves 48.7% weighted Pass@1 and 68.9% Pass@5, surpassing its teacher model, DeepSeek-V3.2, while RTL-Interact-8B achieves 44.9% weighted Pass@1. Additionally, we show that PAPO can reduce average tool calls by 63.8% while improving Pass@1. Both models also outperform all RTL-specialized baselines on VerilogEval v2 and RTLLM v2, demonstrating the effectiveness of our method.

summary.takeaway: 提出RTL-Interact多任务后训练框架，使单一模型能生成RTL、构造EDA检查并依据工具反馈修订，32B模型在CVDP上超过其教师模型。
summary.methods: 结合自动构建的多任务演示与从思维链到工具集成推理的分阶段监督，并提出Pattern-Aware Policy Optimization（PAPO），在GRPO基础上加入正确性门控奖励与任务分组；在CVDP、VerilogEval v2、RTLLM v2上评测。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型在EDA/RTL设计中的工具交互与强化学习后训练。
summary.caveat: 结果集中于数字RTL基准，未涵盖真实流片或更复杂工业设计流程；工具调用减少比例的适用范围需全文核实。

papers.title: LLM Detoxification via Transition-Aware Reward-Guided Representation Sampling
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate toxic content, motivating effective test-time detoxification. Existing representation steering methods often rely on static or coarse interventions and provide imprecise guidance because they inadequately model transitions between toxic and non-toxic generations. We propose Transition-Aware Reward-Guided Representation Sampling (TARGRS), a test-time framework that learns reward guidance over toxicity transitions in latent representation space. During exploration, progressive steering along the toxicity direction constructs trajectories from non-toxic to toxic states. Toxicity scores along these trajectories turn sparse annotations into dense, listwise supervision for a transition-aware token-level reward model. During inference, TARGRS uses this model to guide coarse-to-fine sampling along the opposite, non-toxic direction: coarse sampling identifies the intervention needed to reach non-toxic regions, and refinement selects a detoxified representation with minimal perturbation. Experiments on 10 LLMs across RealToxicityPrompts, BOLD, and AttaQ show that TARGRS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing toxicity by up to 69.38% on RealToxicityPrompts. TARGRS runs nearly as fast as the original LLM while preserving its core capabilities with minimal impact. By intervening in the language decoder space, TARGRS also extends to Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), reducing toxicity by up to 64.23% across 3 representative LVLMs.

summary.takeaway: 提出TARGRS，在潜在表示空间沿毒性—非毒性转变方向学习奖励引导，实现测试时去毒且几乎不增加推理开销。
summary.methods: 通过沿毒性方向的渐进引导构造轨迹，将稀疏标注转为逐token的列表式监督训练转变感知奖励模型；推理时进行由粗到细的反向采样，并扩展至LVLM的解码器空间；在10个LLM及RealToxicityPrompts、BOLD、AttaQ上评测。
summary.relevance: 面向大语言模型与多模态模型的对齐与安全性，属测试时干预方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告毒性降幅最高值，但未说明能力保持的具体量化指标与不同模型间的方差；毒性分类器依赖可能引入偏差。

papers.title: MotorSense: A Video-EMG Dataset of Motoric Representations for Action Understanding
papers.abstract: Computer vision models learn hand action only from its visual consequences, without access to the underlying embodied motor signals. We address this absence with MotorSense, the first large-scale paired egocentric video and surface electromyography (EMG) dataset. MotorSense pairs bimanual EMG bands with egocentric video and yields synchronized video, bimanual EMG and IMU, and audio across 100 hours of unscripted manipulation. EMG offers a powerful scalable alternative to manual annotation: it captures finger movement, hand configuration, and the forces exerted between hand and environment as a dense signal free of occlusion and labeler bias, whereas manual annotation is costly, subjective, and unreliable under occlusion. We use MotorSense to learn sensorimotor alignment, producing an organization of action that is shared across the visual and motoric spaces, through cross-modal pre-training between video and EMG. The resultant vision models are then transferred to downstream tasks that benefit from sensorimotor alignment: in this case, action recognition, 3D hand reconstruction, and 3D contact reconstruction. We further demonstrate a generative application in which EMG motor signals are used to condition a video diffusion model, yielding videos of fine-grained hand manipulation. Across four action-centric computer vision tasks and eight popular video datasets, we demonstrate that sensorimotor alignment provides a stronger foundation for visual representation learning than conventional self-supervised learning methods over video, outperforming every baseline across all tasks and datasets evaluated.

summary.takeaway: 发布首个大规模第一视角视频与双前臂表面肌电配对数据集MotorSense，并证明视觉—肌电跨模态预训练为动作理解提供更强表征。
summary.methods: 采集100小时无脚本操作数据，同步双前臂EMG、IMU、第一视角视频与音频；通过视频—EMG跨模态预训练学习感觉运动对齐，并迁移至动作识别、3D手部重建、3D接触重建及以EMG为条件的视频扩散生成。
summary.relevance: 涉及预训练、自监督表示学习与跨模态生成，强调具身信号作为视觉监督来源。
summary.caveat: 数据采集依赖可穿戴EMG设备，场景限于第一视角操作；摘要未给出各下游任务的具体增益数值。

papers.title: A multispecies foundation model for genome function prediction, gene annotation and sequence design
papers.abstract: Comparative genomics and synthetic biology require models that can interpret, annotate, and design DNA sequences across species, yet genomic models have not combined these capabilities beyond a few well-characterized organisms. Here we introduce Nucleotide Transformer v3 (NTv3), a long-context cross-kingdom foundation model that provides a common backbone for functional prediction, gene annotation and controllable sequence generation across phylogenetically diverse species. NTv3 is pre-trained on more than 128,000 genomes using sequences up to 1Mb and post-trained on 16,262 functional tracks across 15 animal and plant genomes. NTv3 performs comparably to AlphaGenome on matched human assays and matches or exceeds evaluated published models for functional-track prediction across 19 species spanning mammals, birds, fish, plants, fungi and protists. Ablation experiments show that both genome pre-training and expanding functional supervision from human and mouse to 15 species improve track prediction. Leveraging these learned functional representations, NTv3 outperforms leading ab initio gene predictors across mammals, plants and insects, with fewer spurious gene models and improved recovery and reduced fragmentation of long genes. Finally, the same representations can be used with discrete diffusion to design regulatory DNA sequences with specific activity levels. We demonstrate this in plant and fly promoters and enhancers, and experimentally validate the activity and promoter selectivity of the generated fly enhancers. Together, NTv3 unifies genome interpretation, gene annotation and regulatory sequence design across the animal and plant kingdoms, with direct relevance to agriculture, biodiversity research and biotechnology.

summary.takeaway: 提出跨物种长上下文基因组基础模型NTv3，统一功能预测、基因注释与可控调控序列设计。
summary.methods: 在超过128,000个基因组、最长1Mb序列上预训练，并在15个动植物基因组的16,262条功能轨道上后训练；通过消融检验基因组预训练与多物种监督的作用，并用离散扩散设计调控序列，对果蝇增强子进行实验验证。
summary.relevance: 属于生物序列基础模型与预训练主题，兼顾跨物种功能注释与生成式设计。
summary.caveat: 实验验证仅限果蝇增强子的活性与启动子选择性，植物与其它物种的设计能力主要为计算评估；与AlphaGenome的比较限于匹配的人类 assay。

papers.title: Chronos-2: A foundation model for multivariate time series forecasting
papers.abstract: Accurate forecasting with uncertainty quantification is critical in a variety of scientific applications ranging from epidemiology and economics to energy systems and earth sciences. Yet most forecasting models still need to be developed and trained separately for each domain-specific dataset. Time series foundation models (TSFMs) aim to remove this limitation and enable the application of the same model across domains through large-scale pretraining. However, most existing TSFMs treat each time series independently and therefore cannot model interactions among time series and external drivers. Here, we introduce Chronos-2, a foundation model for zero-shot forecasting that models the interactions between multivariate time series and heterogeneous covariates, which commonly arise in scientific applications. The model infers relationships among time series directly from historical context and generates probabilistic forecasts without task-specific treatment. Across various benchmarks, Chronos-2 achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on average by improving skill scores by 5.2 percentage points relative to the strongest baselines and increasing win rates by 10 percentage points. Chronos-2 is also computationally efficient, generating forecasts for 100 time series in under one second on a single mid-range GPU, 50x and 1000x faster end-to-end than the best task-specific point and probabilistic forecasters, respectively. In addition, we demonstrate its effectiveness in diverse scientific settings -- including infectious-disease forecasting, macroeconomic modeling, carbon-flux prediction, and runoff simulation -- where the model matches or surpasses specialized methods developed for each domain. These results show that a single pretrained model can capture structure shared across temporal systems.

summary.takeaway: 提出Chronos-2，一个零样本多变量时间序列基础模型，可同时建模多序列间交互与异构协变量，并输出概率预测。
summary.methods: 通过大规模预训练构建基础模型，从历史上下文直接推断序列间关系，无需任务特定处理；在多个基准及传染病、宏观经济、碳通量、径流等科学场景评测。
summary.relevance: 与预训练主题直接相关，展示跨领域大规模预训练替代逐数据集建模的路径。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明预训练数据规模、协变量类型覆盖范围及基准构成；各领域结论仅为摘要自述。

papers.title: Movens-Zero: Scaling Humanoid Motion Foundation Models with Large-Scale Human Videos
papers.abstract: Scaling humanoid motion foundation models is constrained by the scarcity of diverse, robot-executable data and by the difficulty of jointly learning from heterogeneous multimodal inputs while supporting real-time closed-loop control. We present Movens-5M, constructed from raw Internet videos through clip generation, quality filtering, semantic annotation, motion recovery, and physical refinement with humanoid retargeting and execution verification. It contains 15 million human-motion sequences and 5 million physically executable humanoid-motion sequences spanning over 10,000 hours, aligned with text, RGB video, speech, and music. Building on this data, we introduce Movens-Zero, a scalable understanding-generation-execution architecture that supports joint learning across modalities and real-time closed-loop execution. Task-mixed flow-matching training jointly optimizes a single action expert across seven generation tasks, enabling direct motion generation from text, speech, music, and video. Multimodal Real-Time Chunking connects overlapping chunks under continuously updated instructions and robot states for continuous closed-loop execution. We further introduce Movens-Intent, a four-track benchmark with 8,192 expert-verified condition-motion pairs across text, speech, music, and video. Experiments show consistent gains across all four modalities when scaling execution-verified data from 1% to 100% and action-expert capacity from 64M to 911M parameters, while demonstrating that data quality and cross-modal supervision improve generation and execution.

summary.takeaway: 构建Movens-5M大规模人类视频运动数据集，并提出Movens-Zero多模态理解—生成—执行架构，支持实时闭环人形机器人控制。
summary.methods: 从互联网原始视频经片段生成、质量过滤、语义标注、运动恢复与人形重定向物理精修构建数据；采用任务混合流匹配训练单一动作专家，结合多模态实时分块实现闭环执行，并发布Movens-Intent基准。
summary.relevance: 契合预训练与跨模态理解生成主题，体现大规模数据缩放与多模态联合学习。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告真机部署成功率或与基线方法的对比细节；缩放增益仅描述为自1%到100%数据与64M到911M参数下的一致提升。

papers.title: Advancing Clinical Trial Outcome Prediction with Domain-Specific Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Clinical trial failures are a major barrier to efficient drug development, incurring substantial costs and delaying patient access to effective therapies. Structured approaches such as the Hierarchical Interaction Network (HINT) predict trial outcomes by explicitly modelling interactions between drugs, diseases and protocols, but make limited use of the free text in trial registrations. We evaluate two domain-specific language models, BioBERT (108M parameters) and BioMistral (7B parameters), for phase-level outcome prediction on the TOP benchmark (12,477 trials), representing each trial as text built from ten ClinicalTrials.gov fields. We compare fine-tuning (full fine-tuning for BioBERT, low-rank adaptation for BioMistral) with probing, in which the pretrained model is frozen and only a lightweight classifier is trained on its embeddings. On the held-out test set of each phase, all four language-model variants achieved higher ROC-AUC (0.613--0.772) and PR-AUC (0.649--0.901) than the published HINT results, corresponding to relative PR-AUC gains of 10--20\%. F1 differences were small and mixed, and no model, including HINT, clearly exceeded the F1 of a trivial classifier that predicts success for every trial. Under the configurations tested, probing performed comparably to fine-tuning: fine-tuned models scored highest on ROC-AUC and PR-AUC in Phases I and II, and frozen BioMistral embeddings in Phase III (ROC-AUC 0.772; PR-AUC 0.901), although most differences between variants were below 0.03 and were not tested for significance. These results suggest that pretrained biomedical representations already encode signal relevant to trial outcome, and that probing is a computationally cheaper alternative to fine-tuning for this task.

summary.takeaway: 在TOP基准上比较BioBERT与BioMistral的微调与探针方式用于临床试验阶段结局预测，ROC-AUC与PR-AUC均高于已发表HINT结果。
summary.methods: 将每个试验表示为ClinicalTrials.gov十个字段拼接文本，BioBERT全量微调、BioMistral采用LoRA，另设冻结特征的探针分类器；在12,477个试验的分阶段测试集上评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型与预训练表示在下游任务中的利用方式。
summary.caveat: F1差异小且混杂，无模型明显超过全预测成功的平凡分类器；多数变体间差异低于0.03且未做显著性检验，作者自述配置有限。

papers.title: An open structure-guided RNA foundation model for generalizable prediction
papers.abstract: RNA language models have achieved strong performance across diverse downstream tasks by leveraging large-scale sequence data. However, RNA function is fundamentally shaped by hierarchical structure, making structural information important for pre-training. Existing approaches often depend on noisy annotations or task-specific objectives that can limit generalizability. Here we present structRFM, a structure-guided RNA foundation model pre-trained on 21 million RNA sequence--structure pairs by integrating base-pairing interactions into masked language modelling through a pair-matching operation. We also introduce MUSES, a multi-source ensemble of secondary structures designed to mitigate predictor bias, and a dynamic masking ratio that balances structure-guided and nucleotide-level masking. structRFM learns joint sequence and structure representations as sequence-level, nucleotide-level and pairwise features for broad downstream adaptation. It ranks among the leading models in zero-shot homology classification and establishes new benchmarks for secondary-structure prediction. Its tertiary-structure adaptation, Zfold, consistently improves both three-dimensional predictions and their extracted secondary structures, with performance comparable to AlphaFold3 across CASP15-natural, CASP16 and RNA-Puzzles. structRFM also improves performance on function-prediction tasks and generalizes to newly released RNA families and long non-coding RNAs. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of structure-guided pre-training and highlight multimodal RNA language models for robust structural and functional inference. The complete 21-million-pair dataset, model weights and source code are openly available to support multimodal RNA foundation-model development.

summary.takeaway: 提出结构引导的RNA基础模型structRFM，将碱基配对信息融入掩码语言建模，并发布MUSES二级结构集成与动态掩码比例。
summary.methods: 在2100万RNA序列—结构对上预训练，通过配对匹配操作联合学习序列与结构表示；下游适配包括零样本同源分类、二级结构预测及三级结构适配Zfold。
summary.relevance: 与预训练主题相关，展示多模态结构信息引导的基础模型预训练。
summary.caveat: 摘要为作者自述的基准领先，未给出具体数值与基线差异；Zfold与AlphaFold3的比较限于所列CASP与RNA-Puzzles集合。

papers.title: TradeWar: A Benchmark for Execution-Grounded Trade Negotiation with Adaptive LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Multi-turn negotiation remains a challenging problem for large language model (LLM) agents. While LLMs can conduct natural-language dialogue, existing benchmarks predominantly assess only agreement rates, overlooking whether negotiated commitments actually create value once executed. To address this gap, we introduce TradeWar, a multi-country simulation benchmark that translates negotiation dialogues into concrete tariff and trade-share policies, enforces capacity and network constraints during settlement, and evaluates outcomes via an Economic Health Index (EHI). To solve this execution-grounded task, we propose TACTIC (Trade-aware Adaptive Consolidation and Theory-of-mind for International Commerce), an agent that iteratively refines its negotiation strategy across episodes-without updating base LLM weights-by leveraging prior experience, opponent behavior, and past settlement outcomes. Despite using zero-shot chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting, PromptLLM attains a 75% agreement rate but only 57.1 final EHI (*100), whereas TACTIC reaches 68.8. Across 20 sequential episodes and three seeds, TACTIC's final EHI improves from 58.2 to 73.2, compared with 65.2 for an ablation without cross-episode updates. Under technology-controls and energy-crisis shocks, TACTIC also exhibits smaller performance degradation than PromptLLM and MemoryLLM. These results indicate that CoT deliberation and interaction memory alone do not fully address delayed execution feedback, whereas settlement-grounded adaptation improves long-horizon negotiation in TradeWar.

summary.takeaway: 提出TradeWar多国贸易谈判基准，将对话落实为关税与贸易份额政策并按经济健康指数评估执行结果，同时提出TACTIC智能体。
summary.methods: 模拟多国谈判，结算时施加产能与网络约束，以EHI评估；TACTIC在不更新基座权重下利用历史经验、对手行为与结算结果迭代调整策略，进行20轮序列实验与三类随机种子。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型智能体与对齐/适应，强调执行反馈而非仅达成协议。
summary.caveat: 结果来自模拟环境，未验证真实贸易场景；EHI为自定义指标，摘要未说明其构造与稳健性。

papers.title: Prune Gradually, Adapt Sparsely: Efficient Pruning of Large Language Models at Extreme Sparsity
papers.abstract: Weight pruning can reduce the storage and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), but preserving quality at high sparsity levels remains challenging. Existing methods face a quality-cost trade-off in this regime. One-shot pruning is cheap but degrades sharply as sparsity increases, even when followed by post-pruning recovery. A growing line of work instead optimizes the mask directly from the dense model under the end-to-end objective; among these methods, [Lee et al.,2026], the recent state of the art at extreme sparsity, reaches high quality but at the cost of model-sized optimizer state and auxiliary variables. To address this gap, we propose ETAPS, which prunes gradually and adapts sparsely: it tightens a global sparsity constraint in progressive stages while training a sparse delta with a small, fixed budget. Our key observation is that gradual weight removal keeps each pruning step small enough for sparse adaptation to compensate, allowing the adapted model to provide end-to-end gradients that guide the next pruning decision without model-sized optimizer state. Across six models from 125M to 13B parameters, ETAPS achieves lower perplexity than ELSA at every evaluated sparsity from 50% to 90%, with perplexity reductions of up to 42%. ETAPS is also far cheaper: at 90% sparsity, it prunes LLaMA2-7B on a single H200, where ELSA uses four, with $5.0\times$ smaller total persistent state and 49% fewer GPU-hours. Together, our findings point to a promising direction for achieving high quality in demanding regimes such as extreme sparsity at substantially lower cost.

summary.takeaway: 提出ETAPS，通过渐进收紧全局稀疏约束并训练小型稀疏增量，在极端稀疏下以更低成本取得优于ELSA的困惑度。
summary.methods: 分阶段逐步剪枝，用固定小预算的稀疏delta适配，使适配模型提供端到端梯度指导下一步剪枝决策；在125M至13B六个模型、50%–90%稀疏度上评测。
summary.relevance: 属于大语言模型压缩与高效推理方向，与模型效率主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告困惑度与成本指标，未给出下游任务精度；与ELSA的对比依赖其自述设置。

papers.title: Trainable Vector Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Vector Quantization (VQ) is a rapidly evolving technique for compressing Large Language Model (LLM) weights, reducing memory usage, and speeding up inference. However, extreme compression deteriorates model performance, which is challenging to recover due to the discrete nature of VQ parameters. Existing methods employ training-free approaches that are limited to layer-wise reconstruction loss minimization. To address this limitation, we propose TVQ, a novel method that leverages straight-through estimation to enable gradient descent-based optimization of vector-quantized LLMs. By reformulating VQ LLM optimization with trainable latent weights, TVQ enables arbitrary objective minimization. We constitute our approach by applying TVQ in a block-wise knowledge distillation paradigm, which balances quality and training efficiency, and propose several practical solutions to accelerate training. In experiments on modern LLMs, we demonstrate that TVQ is compatible with modern VQ schemes. As a result, TVQ achieves state-of-the-art quality in low-bit post-training quantization settings with a modest training budget and straightforward PyTorch implementation. For instance, TVQ achieves near-lossless 2-bit quantization for LLaMA2-70B with only 1% accuracy drop on popular Question-Answering benchmarks.

summary.takeaway: 提出TVQ，用直通估计使向量量化LLM权重可梯度优化，并在块级知识蒸馏下实现低比特量化。
summary.methods: 以可训练潜在权重重表述VQ优化，支持任意目标最小化；采用块级知识蒸馏平衡质量与训练效率，并给出加速训练的实现技巧。
summary.relevance: 面向大语言模型压缩与部署效率，与模型高效化主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要结果限于低比特训练后量化设置，2-bit近无损结论基于LLaMA2-70B与常用问答基准，未覆盖更广任务。

papers.title: What Standard Evaluations Hide About Detectors of Hijacked LLM Agents: Rare Attacks, Unseen Tools and Benchmark Transfer
papers.abstract: Detectors can flag hijacked large language model (LLM) agents from the traces of the tools they call. In the eleven evaluations we audited, attacks or anomalies make up 16% to 86% of the test samples, no evaluation varies that share, and six report no test on data from a second benchmark or source. We ask what such evaluations hide. On the AgentDrift and AgentDojo benchmarks we test trained detectors that read tool identities, behavior, call sequences, step embeddings or text, and a released LLM action monitor, AlignmentCheck, with thresholds fixed on training data or set by the monitor's released decision rule. First, at a 2% attack rate a detector with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.879 reaches a precision of 0.076, and the mix of negatives alone moves that precision between 0.039 and 0.117. Second, as tool coverage, the share of test tool calls whose tool was seen in training, falls, detector rankings cross near 50% coverage and reverse below it, because unseen tools map to inputs that training never reached. Dropout on tool inputs largely removes the reversal. Third, no detector trained on AgentDrift ranks AgentDojo traces better than chance (AUROC 0.47 to 0.52), including one that reaches 0.996 within AgentDojo. The monitor, trained on neither, reaches 0.930, but with its open backbone its released decision rule would still mostly raise false alerts at a 2% attack rate (precision 0.096). We turn these findings into a checklist for evaluating trace detectors.

summary.takeaway: 审计十一项评测后发现攻击比例固定、跨基准测试缺失等问题，并实证低攻击率下精度骤降、工具覆盖下降导致排序反转、跨基准迁移接近随机。
summary.methods: 在AgentDrift与AgentDojo上测试基于工具身份、行为、调用序列、步骤嵌入或文本训练的检测器及AlignmentCheck监视器，阈值固定于训练数据或按其发布规则设定，并考察工具输入dropout。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型智能体安全评测与基准泛化，与对齐和评测主题相关。
summary.caveat: 结论基于两个基准与所列检测器，摘要未说明检测器数量与训练细节；所提检查清单尚需更广验证。

papers.title: Experts Exhibit Structured Redundancy: Structure-Preserving Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Sparse MoE mechanism significantly improves the trade-off between model capacity and inference efficiency. However, practical deployment still requires storing all experts, resulting in substantial memory overhead. We show that expert outputs in MoE layers exhibit structured redundancy. Across different models and task categories, the stable rank and entropy effective rank of expert outputs are consistently far below the nominal number of experts, while expert output distributions also exhibit fewer effective modes. Motivated by these observations, we reformulate expert pruning as a structure-preserving expert subset selection problem and efficiently optimize it via a greedy strategy, rather than only independently scoring and ranking individual experts or exhaustively searching over expert combinations. We propose two expert pruning methods under the unified structure-preserving framework: Projection Energy Expert Pruning (PEEP), which preserves the functional subspace by maximizing weighted projection energy, and Distributional Coverage Expert Pruning (DCEP), which preserves the distributional geometry by minimizing weighted coverage error. Both methods incorporate router-derived weights as priors, enabling them to jointly preserve the global structural relationships among experts while accounting for the local importance of individual experts. Experiments on DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate that, at the expert retention ratios of 75% and 50%, our methods outperform the state-of-the-art baselines on the majority of benchmarks and consistently achieve the best average performance across both general tasks and mathematical reasoning tasks.

summary.takeaway: 发现MoE层专家输出存在结构化冗余，将专家剪枝重构为保持结构的子集选择问题，提出PEEP和DCEP两种方法。
summary.methods: 基于专家输出的稳定秩和熵有效秩远低于专家数量的观察，用贪心策略优化保持结构的专家子集选择，并利用路由器权重作为先验；在DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Qwen3-30B-A3B上实验。
summary.relevance: 面向大语言模型的高效部署与压缩，直接关联MoE大语言模型的推理效率与内存开销问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明剪枝对训练阶段或下游微调的影响，也未提供除保留比例外的超参数敏感性分析。

papers.title: Specification-Guided Generation for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate structured outputs, but existing constrained-decoding methods mainly enforce syntax and cannot directly enforce satisfaction of a formal specification. We introduce a neuro-symbolic, specification-guided decoding framework that combines LLM generation with symbolic reasoning. At each step, the framework refines the decoding grammar by filtering out values that cannot be extended to an output satisfying the specification. We present a forward-only variant that guarantees specification satisfaction by construction, and a backtracking variant that revises earlier feasible choices when their downstream consequences leave only values that the LLM itself judges unsuitable. The framework is model-agnostic, requires no retraining, and builds on existing grammar-constrained decoding mechanisms. Experiments on configuration and constraint-solving benchmarks show that the forward-only variant reliably produces specification-compliant outputs while reducing repeated LLM inference compared with rejection sampling and incurring modest symbolic-reasoning overhead. The backtracking variant further reduces cases in which the model is forced to select values that it has itself judged unsuitable, thereby substantially improving adherence to the LLM's stated interpretation of the prompt.

summary.takeaway: 提出神经符号的规范引导解码框架，在生成过程中过滤无法满足形式规范的值，保证输出满足规范。
summary.methods: 结合LLM生成与符号推理，逐步精化解码语法；提供前向变体和回溯变体，基于现有语法约束解码机制，模型无关且无需重训练；在配置和约束求解基准上实验。
summary.relevance: 针对大语言模型结构化输出的规范满足问题，与约束解码和LLM可控生成相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明符号推理开销的具体量级，也未讨论规范复杂性对解码效率的影响。

papers.title: Chance-Constrained Inspection Viewpoint Sequencing for On-Orbit Servicing via Safe Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Autonomous inspection of a target spacecraft is typically the initial step in on-orbit servicing. Planning close-proximity observation viewpoints involves a complex combinatorial problem constrained by coverage, fuel, and safety considerations. This paper models the viewpoint selection as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and applies Proximal Policy Optimization with Lagrangian relaxation to solve it. The system combines a high-level planner, which sequences camera viewpoints on an observation sphere around the target, with a low-level model that assesses each transfer using the Clohessy--Wiltshire (CW) equations for relative motion. The deterministic constraints on single-impulse reachability and $Δv$ cap are enforced directly on the action set. Safety margins are affected by navigation and manoeuvre errors, making the actual clearance stochastic. To address this, a chance constraint on the realised trajectory is implemented, with a Lagrangian multiplier governed by PID control to adapt the penalty during training. The approach is tested on a Galileo-class navigation satellite in medium Earth orbit, modelled as a point cloud where visibility from each viewpoint considers field-of-view and line-of-sight occlusion. Across various risk budgets, the trained policy maintains the keep-out violation rate within the specified limit, achieving coverage close to its maximum and staying within the mission $Δv$ budget. Compared to the usual practice of applying a fixed margin to the keep-out radius and planning deterministically, the chance-constrained policy attains less than half the violation rate at comparable coverage. This makes the collision risk an explicit design parameter, eliminating the need for re-tuning per case. The learned policy selects a viewpoint without the repeated Monte Carlo risk estimates required by a greedy, chance-constrained planner at every decision point.

summary.takeaway: 将航天器近距离检查视点排序建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，用带拉格朗日松弛的PPO求解，并引入机会约束控制碰撞风险。
summary.methods: 高层规划器在观测球上排序相机视点，低层用CW方程评估转移；对单脉冲可达性和Δv上限施加确定性约束，用PID控制的拉格朗日乘子实现机会约束；在Galileo级导航卫星点云模型上测试。
summary.relevance: 属于强化学习在安全约束下的决策应用，与强化学习主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告仿真环境结果，未涉及真实在轨验证；机会约束的统计保证依赖于风险预算设定。

papers.title: ID2Pattern: Pretraining Generalizable Identity Behavior Patterns for Transaction Risk Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Large-scale behavioral pretraining offers a promising route to generalizable representations in online payment systems. However, high-cardinality identity fields such as card, device, and account IDs, though rich in behavioral signals, remain underexploited. Their continually growing vocabularies and limited semantic meaning make existing vocabulary-based and semantics-based encodings ill-suited. Their generalizable signal lies not in specific values, but in the identity behavior patterns they exhibit across a transaction sequence. Building on this insight, we propose ID2Pattern, a pretraining framework that brings these patterns into transaction foundation models. ID2Pattern first encodes identity fields with a Local Anonymous ID (LAID) tokenizer, which captures how each identity appears and recurs within the sequence, independent of its specific value. It then pretrains a multi-scale pattern codebook on unlabeled sequences, which abstracts LAID sequences into discrete behavior patterns for downstream prediction. Experiments on an industrial dataset with over 100M sequences and six public datasets show that ID2Pattern consistently outperforms strong baselines, improving industrial by 4.13% and public datasets by 8.83% on average. Notably, ID2Pattern remains equally effective even when all identity values are unseen during training, highlighting its potential to generalize to new users and markets.

summary.takeaway: 提出ID2Pattern预训练框架，将高基数身份字段编码为局部匿名ID序列并抽象为离散行为模式，提升交易风险基础模型的泛化能力。
summary.methods: 使用Local Anonymous ID (LAID) tokenizer编码身份字段的出现和复现模式，在多尺度上预训练模式码本；在超1亿序列的工业数据集和六个公开数据集上实验。
summary.relevance: 涉及大规模行为预训练与表示学习，与预训练主题相关，并可用于检索增强的风险建模场景。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明模式码本的规模选择依据，也未讨论在线推理时的延迟开销。

papers.title: QUAL: Quantile Alignment Improves Zero-Shot Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) provide zero-shot forecasts for unseen series, but their accuracy varies across datasets. Combining several models can reduce this variability, yet zero-shot deployment provides no target labels for selecting or weighting them. We find that a model pool is useful not only as a final ensemble, but also as a probability reference for transforming each member forecast. Aligning quantiles through this pool-relative reference improves every member forecast in aggregate. Motivated by this finding, we propose QUAL (Quantile alignment), a simple label-free framework for improving and combining diverse TSFMs. QUAL first produces aligned member forecasts, then applies Huber aggregation and rearrangement to obtain a robust combined forecast without training or model modification. On GIFT-Eval, quantile alignment reduces average member MASE and CRPS by 7.4% and 9.8%. The full framework remains robust when weak forecasters enter a candidate pool whose quality cannot be verified in advance. Code is available at https://github.com/junhyeokkang/QUAL.

summary.takeaway: 提出免标签的QUAL框架，通过模型池相对分位数对齐改进并组合零样本时间序列基础模型。
summary.methods: 先对每个成员预测做分位数对齐，再用Huber聚合和重排得到稳健组合预测，无需训练或修改模型；在GIFT-Eval上评估。
summary.relevance: 针对时间序列基础模型的零样本部署与集成，与预训练基础模型的泛化应用相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明模型池构建策略对最终性能的影响，也未讨论计算开销与实时性。

papers.title: Few-shot regulatory sequence design with a genomic language model
papers.abstract: A central challenge in generative biology is translating knowledge learned from natural sequences and experiments into designs with desired functions. In-context learning (ICL) is an emergent capability of large language models that allows them to adapt to new tasks from a few examples without additional training, enabling these models to become general-purpose learners. Here, we show that the genome language model, Evo 2, exhibits generative ICL in biological sequence design. Prompting with just tens of examples conditions Evo 2 to generate novel and diverse regulatory DNA sequences without any additional training. Mechanistic analysis suggests that genomic ICL may originate from induction, similar to phenomena observed in natural language. Reinforcement learning leveraging sequence-to-function models as experiment-derived rewards further strengthens ICL. We first validate this approach by generating enhancers that drive cell-type-specific gene expression in three human cell lines. Extending this approach in vivo, enhancers designed using human regulatory element data selectively label layer 5 extratelencephalic neurons in the mouse cortex with high specificity and stronger activity than existing enhancers. Our study provides evidence of emergent properties in genomic sequence models and introduces a promising approach for improving functional conditioning in generative biology.

summary.takeaway: 展示基因组语言模型Evo 2具备生成式上下文学习能力，仅用数十个示例即可设计新型调控DNA序列，并用强化学习进一步增强功能条件。
summary.methods: 通过提示工程进行少样本生成，机制分析指向归纳效应；利用序列到功能模型作为奖励进行强化学习；在三种人类细胞系增强子和小鼠皮层体内验证。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型的上下文学习与强化学习在生物序列设计中的应用，与生成生物学和虚拟细胞主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明设计序列的脱靶效应评估，也未讨论ICL机制分析的具体实验规模。

papers.title: Diagnostic value of microscopic blood smear examination using a digital cell morphology system for human granulocytic anaplasmosis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Human granulocytic anaplasmosis (HGA) is an emerging tick-borne zoonosis caused by Anaplasma phagocytophilum. HGA typically presents with flu-like symptoms and, in rare cases, can lead to life-threatening complications. Diagnosis relies on the polymerase chain reaction (PCR), which is the most sensitive, as well as serology or blood smear (BS) examination. However, PCR and serology are generally restricted to specialized laboratories and, depending on the organization and specialization of each laboratory, are often unsuitable for urgent diagnoses. Microscopic examination of BS can detect HGA by identifying intragranulocyte morulae but is time-consuming, requires trained microbiologists, and has limited sensitivity. This study evaluated the feasibility of morulae detection by BS analyzed with the CellaVision® system, a digital cell morphology platform for the automated classification of white blood cells and red blood cells, in patients with PCR-confirmed HGA. METHODS: Between 2019 and 2025, for each HGA PCR request at the Colmar Civil Hospitals, two May-Grünwald Giemsa-stained BS were prepared, digitized, and the cells preclassified using the CellaVision® System systematically. Retrospectively, two microbiologists performed a review of the recorded images for all positive HGA PCR results to identify intragranulocyte morulae independently and blinded to each other's findings. RESULTS: A total of 101 PCR tests for HGA were performed in 92 patients, with 5 patients testing positive (median time to results: 6 days). In all 5 patients, images of intragranulocyte morulae were obtained using the CellaVision® system, and the examination was completed in under 15 min. CONCLUSIONS: Using the CellaVision® system for BS analysis with a standardized review protocol simplifies the reading process. The method successfully detected morulae in all confirmed cases included in this preliminary study though prospective validation is still required. However, a negative digitally assessed blood smear must not be interpreted as excluding HGA.

summary.takeaway: 评估CellaVision数字细胞形态系统在PCR确诊的人粒细胞无形体病中检测粒细胞内桑葚体的可行性，所有阳性病例均检出。
summary.methods: 2019至2025年间对HGA PCR检测请求制备两张血涂片并数字化预分类，两名微生物学家盲法回顾图像识别桑葚体；共101次PCR检测，5例阳性。
summary.relevance: 涉及数字细胞形态学与临床诊断自动化，与虚拟细胞和医学图像分析相关。
summary.caveat: 样本量小（仅5例阳性），为回顾性初步研究，需前瞻性验证；阴性数字血涂片不能排除HGA。

papers.title: GRIT: Gradient Masking for Visually Misgrounded Tokens in Text-Rich Reasoning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has recently been extended to vision-language models (VLMs), yet its effectiveness remains limited for text-rich reasoning tasks. We highlight a key factor contributing to this limitation: models frequently arrive at correct final answers despite misperceiving visual information during intermediate steps. We define this phenomenon as Correct-but-Visually-Misgrounded Reasoning (CVMR). Because standard RLVR rewards only final-answer correctness, it fails to differentiate between properly grounded and misgrounded reasoning, reinforcing both equally. Through token-level analysis, we reveal that CVMR tokens exhibit distinct attention patterns that differ systematically from well-grounded ones. Based on this observation, we propose GRIT, a training framework that incorporates visual grounding into RLVR to mitigate the impact of CVMR. Furthermore, to address the lack of text-rich reasoning benchmarks that allow for systematic evaluation across text length and reasoning depth, we introduce GRIT-Bench. Experiments demonstrate that GRIT significantly improves both reasoning accuracy and grounding fidelity over existing RLVR methods.

summary.takeaway: 识别出视觉语言模型在文本丰富推理中“答案正确但视觉误定位”的现象，提出GRIT训练框架将视觉定位融入RLVR以缓解该问题。
summary.methods: 通过token级注意力分析区分误定位token，在RLVR中引入视觉定位信号；构建GRIT-Bench基准用于系统评估文本长度和推理深度。
summary.relevance: 面向多模态大模型的强化学习训练与跨模态理解，与强化学习和多模态学习主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明GRIT对模型通用能力的影响，也未提供大规模人工评估的细节。

papers.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
papers.abstract: Robot agents built on vision-language models depend on both the planner and its harness: the tools, feedback, memory, and recovery logic around it. Can improvements to a large teacher's harness be carried into a compact agent with lower inference compute cost? We present TinyAstral, a two-stage approach. We first freeze an open-weight teacher and improve its harness through recursive self-improvement (RSI): frontier LLM agents read the teacher's trajectories and propose harness edits, and each edit is accepted only if it passes a paired statistical test. We then freeze the final harness, collect teacher trajectories with reasoning and failure recovery, and distill a small student that replaces the teacher in the same harness. On RoboTwin, harness evolution raises the teacher's success from 33.4% to 63.6%; the final 4B student reaches 62.8%. Across four harness versions, distilled 4B students score close to their corresponding teachers, and later versions yield stronger students, showing that harness evolution gains carry into compact models. The harness gains also transfer to other frozen planners without retraining. On identical episodes, the final 4B student outperforms open 4B agents, the open 27B harness-RSI model SenseNova-RoboRSI, and our own teacher model placed in three competitors' harnesses. It stays close to its teacher on all three training benchmarks, and on three benchmarks never used for RSI or training it scores close to a 552B planner running the same harness. On the measured deployment episodes, it uses about one fifth of its teacher's accelerator time.

summary.takeaway: 提出 TinyAstral 两阶段方法，把大型教师模型的自演化 harness 迁移到紧凑的学生操作智能体，使 4B 学生接近教师水平且推理成本更低。
summary.methods: 先用递归自我改进（RSI）优化冻结教师的 harness，每次修改须通过配对统计检验；再冻结 harness 并用教师轨迹（含推理与失败恢复）蒸馏小型学生。在 RoboTwin 等基准上评测。
summary.relevance: 与多模态学习及跨模态理解与生成相关：视觉语言模型驱动的机器人智能体在规划之外还依赖工具、反馈、记忆等 harness 机制。
summary.caveat: 摘要给出的成效主要基于 RoboTwin 等特定操作基准，未说明对更广泛真实机器人场景的泛化；部分对比为相同部署片段上的结果。

papers.title: What Should LLMs Forget: Reinforcement Unlearning of Knowledge Associations
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) acquire extensive factual knowledge during pre-training, which may include sensitive, private, or copyrighted information, motivating the development of unlearning methods that selectively remove specific knowledge while preserving general capabilities. However, existing approaches typically optimize entire responses without explicitly identifying the knowledge to be forgotten, resulting in coarse and uncontrolled forgetting. To address this, we revisit the forgetting target of LLM unlearning and introduce Knowledge Association (KA), which characterizes the association between a query context and its target knowledge and is instantiated by the corresponding conditional predictive distribution, as the fundamental target of forgetting. Based on KA, we propose Knowledge Association Reinforcement Unlearning (KARU), a unified reinforcement learning framework that suppresses forgotten knowledge associations while preserving retained ones. Specifically, KARU derives complementary mechanisms from the KA-based formulation: token-level reward construction for finer-grained forgetting supervision, distribution-level regularization for precise knowledge suppression, and proximity-aware retain sampling to mitigate collateral degradation. Experiments across diverse LLMs on representative benchmarks demonstrate that KARU consistently improves forgetting effectiveness over existing baselines while maintaining comparable retention performance and general utility.

summary.takeaway: 提出以知识关联（KA）为遗忘目标，并用强化学习框架 KARU 精细抑制需遗忘的知识关联、同时保留其余能力。
summary.methods: 将遗忘目标形式化为查询上下文与目标知识间的条件预测分布，基于此设计 token 级奖励、分布级正则和邻近感知的保留采样，在多种 LLM 与基准上评测。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型、强化学习与预训练知识管理，关注如何选择性移除敏感或受版权保护的知识。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体基准数值，仅称相较基线持续提升遗忘效果且保持相近的保留性能与通用能力。

papers.title: Multimodal In-Context Learning with Explicit Rule Induction
papers.abstract: A central challenge in multimodal in-context learning (MICL) arises from tasks that are ill-defined without context and require uncovering the underlying rules from demonstrations. Existing methods predominantly treat MICL as direct input-output mapping, overlooking the importance of explicitly inducing and reasoning over such rules, limiting both performance and interpretability. We propose ERIM, Explicit Rule-Induction for Multimodal In-Context Learning, a unified framework that enhances MICL by explicitly inducing the latent rules governing demonstration samples. Leveraging the reasoning ability of multi-modal large language model (MLLM), ERIM constructs rule-centric MICL datasets, introduces explicit supervision for rule induction, and fine-tunes MLLM to perform explicit rule-induction via a two-stage training strategy that combines mixed cold-start supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments show consistent performance improvements across diverse MICL settings and demonstrate that correctly inducing underlying rules directly leads to stronger and more stable performance.

summary.takeaway: 提出 ERIM 框架，显式诱导多模态示例中的潜在规则，以提升多模态上下文学习的性能与可解释性。
summary.methods: 利用多模态大模型推理能力构建以规则为中心的 MICL 数据集，加入规则诱导的显式监督，采用混合冷启动监督微调与强化学习的两阶段训练。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型、检索增强与对齐及强化学习主题，聚焦多模态上下文学习中的规则归纳。
summary.caveat: 摘要称在多种 MICL 设置上一致提升，但未报告具体数据集或数值；规则构建依赖 MLLM 自身推理质量。

papers.title: Search When Needed, Proceed When Reliable: Metacognitive Reliability Supervision for Efficient Agentic Search
papers.abstract: Efficient agentic search requires large language models (LLMs) to determine whether they can reliably proceed with their current knowledge or need additional external evidence. Supervision based on final-answer correctness or trajectory-level feedback evaluates realized trajectory performance. However, observed trajectory performance is jointly shaped by stochastic generation, retrieval quality, and downstream reasoning. Such signals therefore provide only indirect evidence of how reliable the current decision state was and how retrieved evidence changed its reliability. An effective reward should encourage search when external information is needed and favor searches that contribute to the answer. To this end, we propose a metacognitive framework for training LLMs to make search decisions based on the reliability of their intermediate reasoning states. Our framework estimates the reliability of local conclusions to distinguish whether the current information supports proceeding without search from how much retrieved evidence improves that reliability. The current-state reliability score assesses whether the model can proceed without search. The search-action score measures how retrieved evidence changes estimated reliability. Together, these scores define a reliability-aware process reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), providing finer-grained supervision for search and no-search behavior. Experiments across seven question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than strong agentic-search baselines. Our code and model checkpoints will be open-sourced.

summary.takeaway: 提出元认知可靠性监督框架，让 LLM 依据中间推理状态的可靠性决定是否检索，从而在准确率与效率间取得更好权衡。
summary.methods: 估计局部结论的可靠性分数（当前状态能否不检索继续）与检索动作分数（检索证据对可靠性的改变），组合成过程奖励用于 GRPO 训练，在七个问答基准上评测。
summary.relevance: 与检索增强与对齐、强化学习及大语言模型的高效智能体检索直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体准确率或效率数值，也未说明七个基准之外的泛化情况。

papers.title: ReX-GG: a LLM Ensemble Pipeline for Relation-extraction and Graph Generation
papers.abstract: Current LLM ensemble frameworks focus on multi-step setups with additional modules for answer ranking, often opting for token and span analysis rather than structured outputs, leading to heavyweight architectures with potential fail states along the pipeline. Faster, lighter solutions are more vulnerable to hallucination propagation and can lack output control in more complex pipelines. This paper proposes a customisable, lightweight ensemble workflow of coordinated Large Language Models that leverages JSON-structured outputs and anonymous peer-review ranking to mitigate hallucinatory outputs and single-model failure points. The pipeline is demonstrated on a relation extraction task applied to popular science articles in English, targeting four ontologically-grounded relation types (strong causation, weak causation, contrastive, and compositional), with semantic node canonicalisation and interactive, colour-coded HTML causal graphs as the final output. Performance is evaluated through an anonymous user study, achieving an average perceived accuracy of 0.778 against a human-annotated gold standard. The modular architecture supports flexible deployment across both API-based and in-house LLM setups, and the full framework is released under an open license to foster reproducibility and collaborative research.

summary.takeaway: 提出轻量级 LLM 集成流水线 ReX-GG，用 JSON 结构化输出与匿名同行评审排序进行关系抽取和因果图生成，降低幻觉传播与单模型失败风险。
summary.methods: 协调多个 LLM 输出结构化 JSON，经匿名互评排名筛选，对英文科普文章抽取四类本体关系并做语义节点规范化，输出交互式彩色 HTML 因果图；以匿名用户研究评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型、检索增强与对齐以及图谱构建与表示。
summary.caveat: 评估主要依赖匿名用户研究的主观感知准确率（0.778），非严格自动化基准；摘要未报告与人工标注在关系抽取上的细粒度指标。

papers.title: Rethinking Asymmetry in Self-Supervised 3D Geometry Learning
papers.abstract: Self-supervised learning relies on asymmetry between what a model observes and what it must explain. Recent methods learn 3D geometry from unposed images by predicting cameras and scene structure, then rendering held-out views. To avoid trivial solutions, they impose this asymmetry in the input space, restricting how views interact through separate branches or masked attention. We revisit this design with geometric accuracy, rather than rendering quality, as the main objective. When a held-out view lies between context views, the context already constrains the geometry it observes. We therefore impose the asymmetry in the 3D representation space, excluding held-out views only from the reconstructed scene while a shared backbone uses all views for correspondence. This improves depth and pose estimation over input-space designs. We further exploit view density: sparse and dense observations depict the same scene but provide different amounts of correspondence. Aligning sparse-context features with dense-context features supplies a geometric training signal alongside rendering, without a pretrained geometric teacher. We additionally align features with a frozen vision foundation model, which brings further gains. None of these signals requires geometric annotation, and the resulting model improves geometry estimation over prior self-supervised methods. Controlled experiments isolate the contribution of each component, and self-supervised pretraining also improves subsequent supervised training.

summary.takeaway: 重新审视自监督 3D 几何学习中的不对称性，将不对称施加在 3D 表示空间而非输入空间，并利用稀疏–稠密视图特征对齐提升深度与位姿估计。
summary.methods: 共享骨干使用全部视图建立对应，仅将留出视图从重建场景中排除；对齐稀疏与稠密上下文特征，并与冻结视觉基础模型特征对齐；无需几何标注，并做控制实验与有监督预训练验证。
summary.relevance: 与预训练、自监督与表示学习相关，目标为无位姿图像的 3D 几何学习。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅概括相较先前自监督方法的几何估计提升，未给出具体数据集或数值；部分增益依赖冻结视觉基础模型。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Reveals Spatial Strategies for Slowing Biological Invasions
papers.abstract: Managing biological invasions requires deciding where, when, and how to act while populations continue to grow and spread. Invasive species threaten ecosystems and livelihoods, but limited management resources mean that managers cannot treat every affected area. This study asks how control efforts can be directed across a landscape to slow an invasion while keeping costs low. We develop a reinforcement-learning framework that can use broader spatial context to control biological invasions, using the spongy moth as a case study. The stochastic simulator captures host-dependent growth, short- and long-distance dispersal, density-dependent mating, and the effects of multiple treatments. The reinforcement-learning strategies are compared with benchmarks that are based on local treatment rules. We find that reinforcement learning achieves the lowest mean cost, with its advantage widening as management complexity increases, such as with simultaneous advancing-front control, nascent-colony management, and established-colony containment on heterogeneous-host landscapes. The reinforcement-learning strategies exhibit highly context-dependent treatment behavior, adjusting treatment choices as invasion dynamics evolve and coordinating interventions across long distances, all of which is learned from scratch.

summary.takeaway: 用强化学习框架在景观尺度上规划入侵控制，学习到随入侵动态调整且跨长距离协调的治理策略，平均成本最低。
summary.methods: 以舞毒蛾为案例构建随机模拟器，涵盖寄主依赖增长、短距离与长距离扩散、密度依赖交配及多种处理效果；将 RL 策略与基于局部处理规则的基准比较。
summary.relevance: 属于强化学习应用于生物入侵管理，关注空间策略与成本权衡。
summary.caveat: 结论基于舞毒蛾模拟器而非真实管理试验；RL 策略从零学习，摘要未讨论策略可解释性及现实部署约束。

papers.title: Mapping long-distance jump dispersal risk by leveraging transport infrastructure data and sampling bias correction: a case study with the invasive spotted lanternfly (Lycorma delicatula)
papers.abstract: Long-distance jump dispersal accelerates invasive species spread. Analysis of past jumps can identify invasion pathways and point to locations at risk of future colonization, but spatial bias in survey records obscures patterns. To inform surveillance for the spreading invasive grape pest Lycorma delicatula (Hemiptera: Fulgoridae), we gathered 82,890 agency records of established invasive populations from the United States. We used a clustering algorithm to identify 207 jump dispersal sites, and we developed a bias-aware comparison dataset by filtering records to identify proactive search effort at locations not yet known to hold L. delicatula. We measured points' proximity to a co-produced list of 22 property types encompassing categories with high vehicle traffic, railroads, and related contexts that may transport L. delicatula. Bootstrapping analysis showed that proactive surveys were concentrated near hypothesized influential property types, confirming substantial sampling bias. With this bias accounted for, historical jump dispersal sites were closer than expected to 15 property types, particularly distribution centers, truck rentals, flea markets, and importers. We also compared the lengths of road and rail around these points, finding that jump sites were strongly associated with elevated rail density, whereas models showed limited support for roads as jump sites. Finally, we used the high-risk features to project risk of future jumps across the eastern U.S. using ensemble random forests. Predicted high-risk areas were northeast Illinois, southeast Michigan, and central Ohio. This framework is generalizable, allowing various pathways to be assessed and jump dispersal risk to be projected based on spatially biased surveillance data.

summary.takeaway: 结合交通基础设施属性与采样偏差校正，刻画斑衣蜡蝉长距离跳跃扩散风险，并预测美国东部高风险区域。
summary.methods: 使用 82,890 条机构记录，聚类识别 207 个跳跃扩散点，构建偏差感知比较数据集以反映主动调查努力，测量与 22 类物业类型的邻近性，用自助法检验采样偏差，并以随机森林集成投影风险。
summary.relevance: 涉及检索增强与对齐中的空间数据偏差问题，更具体地说是入侵监测数据中的采样偏差校正与风险制图。
summary.caveat: 相关性与投影基于历史记录和物业邻近特征，不能直接推断因果传播机制；风险预测为模型投影结果。

papers.title: Interpreting Short Tandem Repeat Variations with Genomic Foundation Models in Olive
papers.abstract: Short tandem repeats (STRs) are highly mutable, multiallelic variants with distinctive mutation dynamics and have been associated with phenotypic variation across diverse species. However, genome-wide STR variation remains poorly characterized in olive, and the large number of naturally occurring alleles creates a challenge for variant interpretation. Genomic language models offer a potential way to assess how STR length changes alter learned sequence representations, but their responses to natural multiallelic STR series have not been systematically evaluated. Here, we identified 117,119 polymorphic STRs across 212 Iranian and Mediterranean olive accessions. STRs recovered the major SNP-defined ancestry axes while resolving additional geographically structured subcomponents. We then quantified STR-induced embedding perturbation using three plant genomic language models: AgroNT, PlantCAD2, and GPN. Across all three models, embedding distance generally increased with repeat-length difference from the reference allele, and 7,417 loci were embedding-sensitive in all three models. These signals were robust to fixed-length input construction and exceeded those of matched nonrepetitive indels at most tested loci. Integration with oil-composition associations prioritized four exploratory loci supported by all three models. Overall, we provide a genome-wide olive STR resource and show that plant genomic language models capture reproducible responses to natural STR length variation. Combining cross-model embedding evidence with phenotype association provides a potential framework for prioritizing candidate STRs for further investigation.

summary.takeaway: 该研究构建了橄榄全基因组STR变异资源，并表明三种植物基因组语言模型对自然STR长度变化产生可重复的嵌入扰动信号。
