summary.methods: 在212份伊朗与地中海橄榄材料中鉴定117,119个多态性STR；用AgroNT、PlantCAD2和GPN量化STR引起的嵌入距离变化，并与匹配的非重复indel比较；结合油成分关联筛选候选位点。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于基因组预训练模型的应用评估，检验基础模型表征是否捕捉STR这类多等位变异，与预训练主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要中候选位点仅为探索性优先级排序，未提供功能验证；模型响应与表型之间的因果关系未确立。

papers.title: Hyperbolic Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) seeks to infer the reward function underlying observed behavior, but its predictive accuracy and interpretability depend on how that reward is computed from the underlying features. While prior IRL reward functions have been implemented through a variety of techniques including linear weights, neural networks, or other function approximators, none make assumptions about the geometry of the underlying feature space. Inspired by geometric organization observed in neural circuits, we introduce Hyperbolic inverse reinforcement learning (Hyperbolic IRL), which parameterizes reward as a function of Hyperbolic distance between the feature vector and a learned parameter vector, as well as its Euclidean distance variant. We tested our methods against a range of linear and nonlinear IRL baselines under both deterministic and stochastic policies. Our Hyperbolic approach achieved comparable performance to state-of-the-art models on established benchmarks and excelled in the low data limit and across dense environments. Applied to human navigation among multiple exhibits in a museum room, Hyperbolic IRL reveals reward structure that depends not only on individual exhibit-distance features, but also on non-separable conjunctions between them. Together, these results demonstrate that a Hyperbolic reward parameterization can improve both the predictive accuracy and interpretability of IRL, providing a framework for studying how non-separable, conjunctive structure can begin to explain behavior.

summary.takeaway: 提出Hyperbolic IRL，将奖励参数化为特征向量与学习参数向量之间的双曲距离函数，并考察其欧氏距离变体。
summary.methods: 在确定性和随机策略下，与线性和非线性IRL基线比较；在标准基准及博物馆导航任务中评估，并分析非可分的联合特征结构。
summary.relevance: 该工作改进逆强化学习的奖励表示与可解释性，属于强化学习主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要称在既有基准上性能与最先进模型相当，低数据与密集环境表现更优，但未给出具体数值或统计细节。

papers.title: Towards Understanding the Impact of Plasticity Loss on Reinforcement Learning in Stochastic Environments
papers.abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for sequential decision-making. Despite many high-profile successes in recent years, deep RL is known to be brittle. An emerging line of research attributes this brittleness to a loss of plasticity in neural networks. However, plasticity loss has so far been understudied in stochastic environments. We study this interplay systematically, training SAC agents on three DeepMind Control tasks augmented with controlled levels of observation and action noise. We find that plasticity-preserving methods increase learning robustness on the two harder tasks, with their advantage growing as observation noise increases, while combining resets with layer normalization underperforms resets alone at every observation noise level tested. Further, stochasticity can accelerate the loss of plasticity in harder environments, whereas in easier settings noise can act as a regularizer that sustains plasticity. Lastly, plasticity loss is most pronounced in the early stages of training. In the most challenging stochastic settings, TD instability rather than gradual plasticity loss becomes the dominant failure mode.

summary.takeaway: 系统研究随机环境中可塑性损失对深度强化学习的影响，发现随机性对可塑性损失的作用依赖任务难度。
summary.methods: 在三个DeepMind Control任务上加入受控的观测噪声与动作噪声，训练SAC智能体，比较保留可塑性的方法及reset与layer normalization组合。
summary.relevance: 该文直接探讨强化学习中的可塑性损失与鲁棒性，与强化学习主题相关。
summary.caveat: 结论基于SAC与有限DMC任务及受控噪声设置，摘要未说明是否可推广到其他算法或真实环境。

papers.title: CausalXRL: Explainable Reinforcement Learning through Causal Graph Reasoning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning is a powerful paradigm for training autonomous agents and has achieved impressive performance in complex environments. However, this success often comes at the cost of interpretability, diminishing trust and complicating efforts to debug and improve agent behavior. To address these challenges, we introduce CausalXRL, a novel framework for explainable reinforcement learning (XRL). A key feature of CausalXRL is its use of causal graph reasoning, which provides transparent, structured, multi-level explanations of agent decision-making. We validate CausalXRL through comprehensive case studies and a two-part evaluation: (1) a quantitative analysis of explanation fidelity and causal-structure learning efficiency in benchmark RL environments, and (2) a qualitative expert study assessing explainability in the real-time strategy (RTS) benchmark MicroRTS. The quantitative results show that CausalXRL can provide faithful explanations while efficiently learning causal structures, and the qualitative expert study suggests that participants found CausalXRL useful for inspecting high-level RTS strategies.

summary.takeaway: 提出CausalXRL框架，利用因果图推理为强化学习智能体提供透明、结构化的多层级决策解释。
summary.methods: 在基准RL环境中定量评估解释忠实度与因果结构学习效率；在MicroRTS上进行专家定性研究。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于可解释强化学习，与强化学习主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告定性专家研究认为框架有用，未给出定量解释质量的具体指标或与基线的系统比较。

papers.title: When Is a Game a Markov Decision Process? Correspondences Between Game Theory and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning and game theory describe the same object from two sides. Game theory says what a rational outcome of a strategic interaction is; reinforcement learning says how an agent could reach one through experience. The two literatures nevertheless keep separate vocabularies for identical structures, and the treatments that bridge them present the correspondence as analogy rather than theorem. This monograph supplies the theorems. A game is a Markov decision process in three distinct senses, and every table entry is labelled with the one that applies: a definitional identity, an exact reduction carried by a value- and solution-preserving map, or a structural analogy that fails under identifiable conditions. We take every standard class of game, from normal-form through repeated, stochastic, partially observable, extensive-form with imperfect information, Bayesian, graphical, Stackelberg, potential, coalitional, mean-field and evolutionary games, and identify for each the decision-theoretic model that reinforcement learning already studies under another name. The same treatment is applied to solution concepts: Nash equilibrium and the fixed point of the Bellman optimality operator, quantal response equilibrium and the soft Bellman operator, the Shapley value and credit assignment, Blackwell approachability and no-regret learning. We map each model class onto the training procedures sound for it and record the complexity of the associated solution problems. A final part collects the correspondences that do not hold: the non-stationarity that invalidates the independent-learner reduction, the impossibility results that forbid uncoupled convergence to Nash equilibrium, and the gap between the coarse correlated equilibria that no-regret self-play reaches and the correlated equilibria it is credited with.

summary.takeaway: 该专著系统建立博弈论与强化学习之间的对应关系，并按定义等同、精确归约和结构类比三类标注每种对应。
summary.methods: 覆盖正规式、重复、随机、部分可观测、不完全信息扩展式、贝叶斯、图、Stackelberg、势、联盟、平均场和演化博弈等类别；同时映射Nash均衡与Bellman最优算子不动点、Shapley值与信用分配等解概念。
summary.relevance: 该文澄清博弈论与强化学习共享的决策论结构，直接关联强化学习主题。
summary.caveat: 这是理论综述性专著，摘要未提供实验验证；其对应关系的适用范围依赖所标注的类别。

papers.title: Protamine gene expression is associated with sperm motility in rams: An integrative experimental and gene network analysis.
papers.abstract: Protamine 1 (PRM1) and protamine 2 (PRM2) are essential regulators of sperm chromatin condensation and genome integrity, and their dysregulation has been associated with impaired male fertility. However, their role in rams remains insufficiently characterized. This study investigated the relationship between protamine gene expression and semen quality in rams and explored their potential upstream regulatory mechanisms using gene regulatory network (GRN) analysis. Fifteen ejaculates from five rams were analyzed. Based on total sperm motility using computer-assisted sperm analysis (CASA), ejaculates were classified into a high-motility group (n = 8) and a low-motility group (n = 7). PRM1 and PRM2 expression levels were quantified by RT-qPCR. Following normality confirmation (p > 0.05), parametric tests were applied using the ejaculate as the biological experimental unit. Samples with reduced motility showed significantly lower expression of both protamines (p < 0.01). Moreover, progressive sperm motility was strongly correlated with both PRM1 (r = 0.71, p = 0.019) and PRM2 (r = 0.69, p = 0.03) transcript levels. Cross-species GRN inference using scGeneRAI and a reference human spermatogenesis dataset identified several hypothesis-generating candidate transcription factors, including HMGB4, HMGB1, H2AFZ, NKX6-1, and SMC3, consistently supported across multiple bootstrap resampling runs. These findings demonstrate a strong association between protamine expression and sperm motility in rams. While the identified candidate regulators provide a valuable framework for future species-specific validation, they also highlight promising candidate molecular biomarkers of male fertility in livestock.

summary.takeaway: 在公羊中，PRM1和PRM2表达降低与精子活力下降相关，并给出若干候选上游转录因子的假设。
summary.methods: 分析5只公羊的15份精液，按CASA总活力分为高活力组（n=8）和低活力组（n=7），用RT-qPCR定量PRM1/PRM2；以scGeneRAI和人类精子发生参考数据做跨物种GRN推断。
summary.relevance: 该研究使用基因调控网络推断探索公羊精子质量的调控机制，与GRN/Regulon主题相关。
summary.caveat: 样本量小且为关联性研究，候选转录因子为跨物种推断的假设生成结果，未做物种特异性功能验证。

papers.title: A high-resolution protein-RNA binding atlas for structure-aware interaction prediction and post-transcriptional regulatory modeling
papers.abstract: RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) control post-transcriptional gene expression by regulating RNA processing, localization, stability, and translation. However, our understanding of RNA regulation remains limited by the resolution, scale, and uniformity of available RBP binding maps. Here we introduce eclair CLIP (ecCLIP), a high-throughput CLIP-seq platform that combines endogenous protein tagging for uniform affinity capture with ligation-free library preparation to generate high-resolution RNA-protein binding profiles. We applied ecCLIP to 67 endogenously tagged RBPs in HEK293T cells, generating a high-quality transcriptome-scale atlas that recovered known binding preferences and captured post-transcriptional regulons linked to RNA half-life. To test the utility of the atlas, we incorporated ecCLIP into Borzuki, a Borzoi-derived sequence-to-function model trained on complementary RNA degradation, expression, CLIP, and Perturb-seq data. Inclusion of ecCLIP data improved RNA half-life prediction and assessment of 3' UTR variant effects on RNA stability, demonstrating that our atlas helps capture RNA dynamics. To directly model the cis-regulatory grammar underlying these RBP-RNA interactions, we developed Pythia, a structure-aware neural network architecture that incorporates context-free grammar-inspired fixed convolutions to explicitly encode RNA base-pairing features. Pythia predicted RBP binding from sequence and structural context and decomposed predictions into sequence- and structure-dependent components. We tested this decomposition for five RBPs using massively parallel reporter CLIP (MPRC) binding assays in cells, using synthetic RNA libraries containing mutations designed to preserve or disrupt predicted RNA structures across nominated binding sites. We used the same MPRC strategy to confirm allele-specific binding effects for variants prioritized by Pythia. Together, ecCLIP and Pythia provide a resource for structure-aware decoding of RNA-protein interaction grammar and interpretation of post-transcriptional regulatory variation.

summary.takeaway: 构建ecCLIP高分辨率蛋白-RNA结合图谱，并开发结构感知模型Pythia以解析RBP-RNA结合的序列与结构语法。
summary.methods: 在HEK293T中对67个内源标记RBP进行ecCLIP；将数据并入Borzuki模型评估RNA半衰期与3' UTR变异效应；Pythia用固定卷积编码RNA碱基配对特征，并通过MPRC实验检验结构依赖分解及等位特异性结合。
summary.relevance: 该工作提供转录后调控与RBP regulon资源及结构感知建模，涉及GRN/Regulon和扰动实验设计。
summary.caveat: 实验主要在HEK293T细胞系中进行，体内其他细胞类型的可迁移性未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: Rice bZIP11 acts as a transcriptional repressor that negatively regulates photosynthesis in response to nitrogen deficiency.
papers.abstract: Nitrogen (N)-deficiency responses, which are closely linked to plant biomass and crop yield, differ between plant tissues. A previous in silico analysis suggested that four transcription factors, including OsbZIP11, play vital roles in the gene regulatory network governing N-deficiency responses (NDRs) in rice roots. To investigate the role of OsbZIP11 in NDRs, the phenotypes, functional responses, and gene expression of rice plants that either lacked functional OsbZIP11 or overexpressed OsbZIP11 were analyzed. Contrary to expectations, OsbZIP11 function showed an overwhelmingly stronger association with photosynthetic gene expression than with any other physiological process, including the expression control of N-related genes. OsbZIP11 directly suppressed numerous photosynthetic genes as a transcriptional repressor. N deficiency increased OsbZIP11 expression in shoots, consistent with N deficiency-reduced photosynthetic activity. Furthermore, removing functional OsbZIP11 and OsbZIP11 overexpression produced opposite effects on the expression of genes involved in the light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis and carbon dioxide fixation, as well as on growth and grain yield. These findings indicate that OsbZIP11 is a critical factor responsible for N deficiency-induced decreases in photosynthesis in rice and provide new insights into the mechanism underlying the coordination of C and N acquisition.

summary.takeaway: 水稻OsbZIP11作为转录抑制因子负调控光合作用基因，并介导氮缺乏引起的光合下降。
summary.methods: 分析缺失功能或过表达OsbZIP11水稻植株的表型、功能响应和基因表达；检验其对光合基因的直接抑制及与氮缺乏诱导表达的关系。
summary.relevance: 该研究揭示氮缺乏响应基因调控网络中的转录因子功能，与GRN/Regulon主题相关。
summary.caveat: 结论主要基于水稻突变与过表达实验，摘要未说明田间多环境验证或其他作物中的保守性。

papers.title: Spatialsnake: a flexible workflow for spatial transcriptomics analysis across platforms
papers.abstract: Background: Spatial transcriptomics technologies measure gene expression at different spatial resolutions and generate diverse data outputs. Existing workflows support a range of platforms and analyses, but combining methods and extending analyses to selected populations or tissue regions can require additional scripts and repeated data preparation. Findings: We developed Spatialsnake, a flexible workflow built on SpatialData and Snakemake for analysing processed outputs from Visium, Visium HD, Stereo-seq, Xenium and MERFISH. A common command-line interface supports single- and multi-sample analysis, with adjustable parameters and saved intermediate results. Users can select populations, tissue regions or distance-based neighborhoods, repeat clustering and annotation, and map refined labels back to the full dataset. Additional modules support cell-type composition estimation, spatial-domain identification, cell-cell communication inference, regulon analysis and sample-level comparisons. We demonstrate these functions using mouse-brain Visium and colorectal cancer Visium HD datasets. Joint analysis of three colorectal cancer sections retained 1,527,987 bins and enabled further analysis of 223,632 epithelial bins, linking epithelial subpopulation annotations to their locations within the complete tissue. Conclusions: Spatialsnake provides a unified workflow for spatial transcriptomics analysis across sequencing- and imaging-based platforms. Its flexible analysis modules support both whole-tissue analysis and further investigation of selected cell populations and tissue regions.

summary.takeaway: 推出 Spatialsnake，一个基于 SpatialData 和 Snakemake 的灵活空间转录组分析流程，统一支持 Visium、Visium HD、Stereo-seq、Xenium 和 MERFISH 的处理后输出，并允许对选定细胞群体或组织区域重复分析与细化注释。
summary.methods: 流程基于 SpatialData 与 Snakemake 构建，提供统一命令行接口，支持单样本与多样本分析、可调参数与中间结果保存；用户可选择细胞群体、组织区域或距离邻域，重复聚类与注释并将细化标签映射回全数据集；模块涵盖细胞类型组成估计、空间域识别、细胞间通讯推断、regulon 分析与样本级比较；以小鼠脑 Visium 和结直肠癌 Visium HD 数据作演示，并对三张结直肠癌切片进行联合分析。
summary.relevance: 其 regulon 分析模块涉及基因调控网络推断，与该研究主题 GRN / Regulon 直接相关；同时该流程提供空间域识别与细胞间通讯等模块，可在空间转录组数据上联合支撑调控网络与微环境分析。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅说明模块支持 regulon 分析，未交代所用具体方法、统计模型或验证结果；演示限于小鼠脑 Visium 与结直肠癌 Visium HD 两类数据，对其他平台的实际表现未给出评估。
